subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-visible session-level command that can switch the current conversation to another configured agent without changing global bindings?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the permanent behavior affects routing ownership, channel command authorization, session persistence, and cross-agent security boundaries.

options.title: Design a gated core command
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design that defines authorized senders, session-state storage, audit/recovery, and tests for default routing plus switched routing.

options.title: Keep bindings static
options.body: Decline runtime channel switching and keep configured bindings plus Gateway restart/reload as the only supported cross-agent routing model.

options.title: Expose a plugin seam first
options.body: Require a generic channel/session-routing extension point before any concrete `/agent` command ships.

recommendation.title: Design a gated core command
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design that defines authorized senders, session-state storage, audit/recovery, and tests for default routing plus switched routing.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested behavior extends the multi-agent routing feature history most directly associated with this owner signal.
